answer: Stake-weighted jury lottery: grading seats are drawn each epoch by locked stake, so a seat costs real POA to hold and a jade farm must lock stake per clone to draw seats at all. A garden of honest graders each holds a small stake and earns steady fees, while an ember of sybils either stays seatless and voiceless or pays the stake on every head, and a single conviction burns the stake of the whole drawn panel.
